question: Should core Skill Workshop adopt exact proposal previews and bind approval-generated apply, reject, and quarantine decisions to the proposal version shown in the approval prompt?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but this adds a permanent core operator workflow and an upgrade-visible fail-closed approval contract that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept the workflow
options.body: Land exact previews and version-bound approval execution as the canonical Skill Workshop safety model.

options.title: Narrow to preview
options.body: Keep the read-only review action but remove approval-time version binding until that lifecycle contract is separately approved.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Retain metadata-only approval prompts and pause or close this proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept the workflow
recommendation.body: Land exact previews and version-bound approval execution as the canonical Skill Workshop safety model.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is assigned to shakkernerd, who also has substantial merged history in the Skill Workshop lifecycle and write-safety surfaces.
